name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ClassLock.walk_lock
title: Depth-l class lock: walks of class-covered slot moves never create an all-ones slot
statement: Slot programs m : N -> Bool -> Bool; m is alive on the string x when m i (x i) = true for every level i. The class of m is its entries at the levels below l. Let z assign to each program a string that depends only on its class and lies in the class cube below l whenever no level below l is dead. If at time 0 no slot is alive on the string z assigns to its class, and every step changes one slot d either so that every string alive in the new d is alive, before the step, in some slot of the new d's class, or by a cover flip at a level L < l whose cover has a nonempty entry at every level below L, entry 1 at (L, b) and only 1-entries after L, then no slot is ever all-ones.
